Steps:

The user stories:
U1: rerun baseline, Tuple, and Serialized payloads to compare performance between 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 Kafka releases. Sinks: In-Memory Transport > Hdfs sink, Direct Binding Transport > Hdfs Sink, Kafka > Hdfs Sink. This is likely performance testing/benchmarking task, maybe writing/updating test scripts to run payloads and compare.
U2: upgrade to 2.0.3 release of Reactor, to inherit latest optimizations to improve XD performance. This is dependency upgrade in build/config.
U3: have JMX turned-off by default, to take advantage of performance throughput benefits. Configuration change/default change.
U4: fix outstanding build issues (local ./gradlew dist and distZip targets), so evaluate publish builds works as expected. Build script fixes.
U5: clean-up compiler and javadoc warnings from the build, so no warnings in build sysout. Code cleanup, fixing warnings.
U6: start multiple instances of {{xd-container}}'s through the RPM scripts, so easily spin-up instances on same node/vm. RPM script enhancement.
U7: refer to OOTB batch jobs and documentation, jump to right job section and review details. Documentation update/cross-referencing.
U8: refer to analytics tab docs, understand how to use various widgets from streaming pipeline. Documentation update.

So the increment includes: performance test rerun/tooling, dependency upgrade, config default change, build fixes, warning cleanup, RPM script improvement, documentation for batch jobs and analytics tab.
